name: Ulcerian Defiance
definition: Resistance enacted from within a containing system that cannot be exited without cost.

name: The Exile at the Gate
definition: Departure that remains complicated by a prohibited or unresolved belonging left behind.

name: Custodial Tenderness
definition: Care administered by a system whose primary function is control, not welfare.

name: The Refusenik Posture
definition: The stance of one who exits a containing system without pretending the exit resolves it.

name: Ledger Guilt
definition: Guilt structured as an unclosable account rather than a resolvable debt.
